outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fantasy battle animation pose sheet. Reference establishes Drowned Antler Sovereign: massive FOUR-legged marsh stag, bark-and-moss armored hide, huge branched paired antler crown with dangling bone charms and purple reed strands, long shaggy leaf tail, cloven hooves with thick rootlike forelegs, narrow stag muzzle and dark green mane. Paint exactly twelve whole-body articulated poses in FOUR columns THREE rows evenly spaced grid, generous gutters, transparent RGBA empty background. Constant size and fixed three-quarter side view facing screen right, complete huge antlers and tail inside every cell. Reading order: 1 standing relaxed idle; 2 inhaling chest raised head slightly lifts charms sway; 3 walk near foreleg forward far foreleg back; 4 passing walk near foreleg planted far foreleg flexed beneath chest; 5 opposite contact FAR foreleg forward NEAR foreleg back; 6 antler attack windup crouched hindquarters neck draws back; 7 antler charge lowered head crown thrust forward with extending hindlegs; 8 defense planted hooves lowered protective antler crown; 9 hit recoil neck pulled aside; 10 death foreknees buckle chest lowers nearly to ground; 11 collapse onto side rear legs fold antlers tilt; 12 dead fully side-lying head resting eyes closed antlers and tail still attached. Keep exact four legs, two branched antlers, original dangling ornaments and foliage armor throughout; no changing into humanoid or ordinary deer. Real anatomical animation not translated duplicates. No text, no scenery, no shadows, no additional creatures, no gore. Detailed original painted game art matching reference. Actual transparent background.

review_notes: 11 packed candidate frames: nine retained original paintings and two new opposite-diagonal hoof lifts. Original repeated movement leads are excluded; the planted pose separates the two controlled lifts. Short-step candidate, not accepted translated gait.

Original RGB checkerboard uses owner-approved connected neutral190/tolerance16/edge2 with explicitly inspected background seeds in antler, chain, pendant and leg apertures. Ivory ornaments and olive hide are not globally neutral-keyed.

The original side corpse has a closed dark eye and remains selected with the original kneel and side-fall. No unnecessary new death art. Crop bands exclude neighboring horn, tail and pendant fragments without reshaping owned art.

New green masters use explicit distance75/edge2 preparation. The fixed standing reference contains a tiny neighboring tail fragment, explicitly excluded by the generation prompts; generated poses have no such fragment.

Antler shape and ornaments/runes, head/body/tail proportion, hoof depth/support, ground anchors, edge flecks and actual action/death timing remain for full-roster refinement. Actual-alpha atlas and registered art desk are production inspection, not final acceptance. No tests/imports/exports or gameplay/save/footprint changes.
